water amount, donor identity and thermal field remain explicit separate inputs

binding can support coupled outward water but is not integrated with groundwater runtime

interface sensitivity output is unchanged
O(1) lookup adds no extra SWAP solve

no MODFLOW cell or tile cardinality assumption is introduced
deep-vadose remains an external component
component storage-transition accounting is unchanged
binding consumes a thermal field view and is independent of soil-water solver implementation
no drainage, root, bottom or other process physics is duplicated
caller supplies donor identity explicitly; binding has no HeadCalc internal knowledge
no physical option is changed by numerical policy
system-level bounded-cost and fallback behavior are outside scope
